notes.title: Succubus Challenge Launch
notes.notes:
Hi everybody, I just want to share that recently I launched a small project, which is already complete and released.

This is a small game. I made it to learn and test the engine, which I will use for my future works.

If you would like to try it out, the game has a free demo.

The game is not perfect, but I hope you will find it enjoyable.

Here is the description of the game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3277560/Succubus_Challenge
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44733699/6fad6a7bda2e433e892c29de053205af31fee910.png[/img]
Do you want a more difficult fight or an easier one? You have the option to choose the difficulty level for each battle.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44733699/f7e1574458bbe9d81ab2794ac6be625c7904dda4.png[/img]
In each turn, your succubus opponent will carry out a sexual attack on you; to win, you must fight and beat the demon by using the unholy trinity of headpat, handhold, and kissing.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44733699/841532ccfc59edb9fc2241f9ca268701f3cf997d.png[/img]
Perhaps you need a little additional assistance before the battle? Interact with the succubus girl and gain a buff that will greatly help you during the fight.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44733699/eaed3ec1343ba714de3300722c7ed25e6ca6b14f.png[/img]
After a victory, you will be granted a score, which is needed for content and unlocking progression; the more you win, the more sexual scenes you can see.

notes.title: Second Project Announcement
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44733699/7d7060ac28308d46e4f49d155c39597166c37166.png[/img]
First of all, I wish you all a happy new year and am celebrating the fact that Married Life With A Lamia passed 200 units in December, which is great news for me. But this is not the reason I'm writing this thread right now.
In the last few months, I started working on my new project, and I feel it's ready to arrive on Steam as an early access. The game still has a long way to go, but currently you have around an hour of play time, depending on your style of play.
But now let's skip to the game introduction. My second project is My Life in a Monster Girl Paradise!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44733699/69ab30fc574974532c9d86a6aa155ad80ac8684e.png[/img]
My Life In A Monster Girl Paradise is an 2D Erotic Monster Girl Game. The game focuses on lewd battles and dating as the result of an interspecies romance between a human and a monster girl. Its basically a simple monster girl collection game with only a basic background story. For now, I still not decided how much story I will implement into the game.
The game page and demo version are already out on Steam, and the product will arrive probably in February if everything goes well with two new monster girl species and their related contents. You can wishlist or try out the demo here, and please leave a review. Whether you play my first game or my second, it would help a lot.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2736290/My_Life_In_A_Monster_Girl_Paradise/
For further details, you can keep reading below or just check out the link for more pictures and trailers.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44733699/fcd20774dd2639b261d8d2b16598e867a8b5661a.png[/img]
Fight and befriend different types of monster girls and unlock extra features by inviting them to live in your village.
Current Race List:Minotaur, Lamia, Alraune, Kitsune, Centaur, and Mershark.
Gather the resources for house building and explore the world, meeting new monster girl species.
Simple Battle-Fuck System: Kissing, Pussy Caress, Breast Caress, Ass Caress, and you better be careful because if the girls are close to losing, they will try to tempt you and drain you dry.
Different minigames, such as fishing and tavern serving
Different Quests and tasks given by each monster girl.
Dating with interactions such as kissing, handholding, and headpats as well.
Level up your relationship and unlock new scenes.
Fast Travel and Camping Features.
All visuals are fully animated.
Erotic Scenes with different variants and situations.
